prompts.display_text: Pin a country where a new temple was dedicated in 2025 (not rededications).
prompts.text_original: A country where a temple was dedicated in 2025 (not counting rededications).
prompts.citation: Church temple list (original dedication dates), 26 Oct 2026
prompts.summary: Temples dedicated in 2025 reached Africa, the Pacific and the Americas. Abidjan and Nairobi were the first temples in Côte d'Ivoire and Kenya, and Auckland New Zealand, Antofagasta Chile and Bahía Blanca Argentina were also dedicated. Four new temples were dedicated in the United States, including Elko Nevada and Farmington New Mexico.

answers.name: United States
answers.fact: Elko Nevada, Farmington New Mexico, Grand Junction Colorado and 1 more dedicated in 2025.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country or territory whose first temple was dedicated in 2010 or later.
prompts.text_original: Pin a country or territory whose first temple was dedicated in 2010 or later.
prompts.summary: Since 2010 temples have reached many new nations. Kyiv, Ukraine (2010) was the first in the former Soviet Union, and later came Paris (2017), Rome (2019), Kinshasa (2019) and Bangkok (2023). In 2026 Zimbabwe, Cambodia and Nicaragua each got their first temple.

answers.name: Ukraine
answers.fact: Kyiv, 2010, the first in the former Soviet Union.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country where, Saints says, David Kennedy won or sought official recognition for the Church in the late 1970s.
prompts.text_original: Saints vol. 4 ch. 19 (late 1970s): David Kennedy had won official recognition for the Church, or was seeking it, in these countries. Pin one.
prompts.summary: In the late 1970s David Kennedy worked to win official government recognition for the Church in other countries. He had already gained it in Portugal and in Poland, which was unusual for a communist state at the time. He was still seeking it in India, Sri Lanka, Pakistan, Hungary, Romania and Greece.

answers.name: Poland
answers.fact: Recognition already won, unusual for a communist state then.

prompts.display_text: Pin a country or territory that Saints names in the Church's growth across Oceania about 1915.
prompts.text_original: Saints vol. 3 ch. 11 (about 1915): the Church was expanding in Oceania. Pin a country or territory it names: strong branches, a reopened mission, or a mission press.
prompts.summary: Around 1915, while Europe was at war, the Church was growing in the Pacific. Saints in New Zealand, Australia and Samoa met in strong branches with Relief Societies, Sunday Schools and choirs, and the Maori Agricultural College had opened in Hastings, New Zealand, in 1913. The Church was taking root again in Tonga, and the Tahiti Mission printed a Church periodical in Tahitian on its own press.

answers.name: New Zealand
answers.fact: Strong branches; the Maori Agricultural College opened in Hastings in 1913.

answers.name: Tonga
answers.fact: Taking root again after more than ten years closed to missionaries.

answers.name: United States
answers.fact: Hawaii: the Saints there and the Church school at Laie.

answers.name: French Polynesia
answers.fact: The Tahiti Mission ran its own printing press.
